event.title: FSFE at GNU/LinuxDay in Vorarlberg in Dornbirn, Austria

body.p:
Join us at GNU/LinuxDay Vorarlberg in Dornbirn. Step by at the FSFE booth and engage with us about Free Software and learn more about our current activities for promoting software freedom. At 12:00 (CEST), Bonnie Mehring from the FSFE will give the talk
"Hands-on: Wie man Gen Z und Alpha für Freie Software begeistern kann", walking you through the FSFE youth activities and exploring practical ways to engage younger generations with Free Software.

The event takes place on 26 September 2026 at HTL Dornbirn, Höchsterstr. 73, A-6850 Dornbirn, Austria, from 09:00 to 18:00. Admission is free and no registration is required. The event will be in German.
